theorems.statement: ∀ (F : Type) [NormedField F] [CompleteSpace F], (∀ x y : F, ‖x + y‖ ≤ max ‖x‖ ‖y‖) → ∀ q : F, ‖q‖ < 1 → Multipliable (fun d : ℕ => 1 - q ^ (d + 1)) ∧ (∏' d : ℕ, (1 - q ^ (d + 1))) ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, Multipliable (fun d : ℕ => (1 - q ^ (d + 1)) ^ k) ∧ (∏' d : ℕ, (1 - q ^ (d + 1)) ^ k) = (∏' d : ℕ, (1 - q ^ (d + 1))) ^ k ∧ (∏' d : ℕ, (1 - q ^ (d + 1)) ^ k) ≠ 0
